step1_analysis.description: A wideband amplifier topology (Cherry-Hooper) with emitter-follower feedback, typically used in optical communications for high bandwidth and low group delay distortion. Note: The provided netlist appears to be an incomplete extraction containing only passive components and independent sources, lacking the active transistors.

paper_reference.title: Analysis and Design of HBT Cherry–Hooper Amplifiers With Emitter-Follower Feedback for Optical Communications

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on transconductance and load resistors. Assuming gm ~ 10mS and Rload ~ 1kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 CMOS has lower gm/Id compared to SiGe HBTs, so achieving the same gain might require higher power or yield slightly lower gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by RC time constants of the Cherry-Hooper stages.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 fT is around 40-50 GHz, which is comparable to the 47-GHz SiGe process, so similar bandwidths (~10 GHz) are achievable.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the amplifier core

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With VDD=1.8V and I_total ~ 15mA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled for 1.8V supply (paper used 3.3V), current might be similar to maintain gm, leading to slightly lower overall power.

Group Delay Distortion.description: Variation in group delay over the bandwidth of interest

sky130_expected.calculation: Difference between max and min group delay in the passband.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Achieving Bessel-like response in CMOS might have slightly more variation due to lower intrinsic gain and parasitics.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and group delay of the Cherry-Hooper amplifier. Note: Values (1k, 0) have been appended to the DUT components to prevent ngspice syntax errors due to the incomplete extraction.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Cherry-Hooper Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT (Values appended to prevent syntax errors from incomplete extraction)
V1 N4 LABEL_NET_0 0
V2 N8 N3 0
V3 N0 N10 0
I1 GND N5 0
I2 N3 N2 0
I3 N3 N2 0
I4 vo1 N9 0
R1 N0 GND 1k
R2 N2 N4 1k
R3 N5 N8 1k
R5 N6 N7 1k
R4 N3 N9 1k
R6 N2 N10 1k
R7 N5 N6 1k
R8 N7 GND 1k
R9 vo1 N7 1k
R10 N9 LABEL_NET_1 1k

* Biasing and Sources
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5
VN8 N8 0 dc 1.8
VN0 N0 0 dc 1.8

.control
* DC Analysis
op
let power = -(i(VN8) + i(VN0)) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1M 100G
let gain_db = vdb(vo1)
meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=1M
let gain_db_3db = low_freq_gain - 3
meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_db_3db fall=1

* Group Delay Calculation
let phase_rad = cph(v(vo1))
let group_delay = -deriv(phase_rad) / (2 * 3.14159265359)
meas ac gd_1M find group_delay at=1M

* Transient Analysis
tran 1p 10n
.endc
.end
